listing.name: Vexillographic Menagerie
listing.summary: Hi! I made some things! And you can have them! Specifically, the things are flags. Made them for various things, but they won't see any use for a good while, so they're on the table.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of custom flags for use in the game.

description:
Vexillographic

Menagerie

Do you, yes YOU! often find yourself in need of a good flag? Do you wish there were more options? If you answered "yes" to one or more of these questions, then I shall provide!

Spoiler[close]

Note: If I ever get around to making a full faction mod, one of these is likely to be the first to go, and will be removed from the download if so. But it's not likely I get that far anyways :P

Now Available: The Path of Ludd. Display your faith and righteousness with a kickass flag, as Ludd clearly intended. Separate from the All-in-One pack* pending a Season Two pack Eventually™

Download here :3

I've set up a server to discuss my mod(s) :3

aiDescription: Adds a variety of custom flags, including one for the faction 'The Path of Ludd'. These flags can be used to personalize ships and factions. The mod is designed to be standalone and does not require other mods to function.
